# Serving capabilities

<!-- Generated by crates/ds4-core/examples/serving_docs.rs. Do not edit. -->

This table is generated from `ds4_core::serving_caps` and the resolved
plan's `controls`, which also supply `ds4-perf serving-controls`.
`qualified` describes the recorded artifact and workload scope, not every
quantization, context, concurrency, media input or feature combination.
`unverified` means implemented (`Support::Present`); `none` means unsupported.
Consult the [release ledger](releases/v0.1.3.md) and
[family contracts](ds4-dfm-model-families.md) for evidence and limits.

## Bounds and allocator controls

The runtime context cap is an admission bound, not a qualification claim.
`—` means the capability table declares no bound or recorded value; it does
not mean unlimited capacity. Qualified columns retain their workload scope.

Scheduler chunk candidates: 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192. The resolved plan only offers
values at or below its known native capacity. Unknown capacity offers no
candidate. These are scheduler controls, not measurements or speed claims.

## Qualification notes

- **K-EXAONE 236B A23B:** exact reuse qualified; LLLG partial checkpoints await live qualification.
- **dots3-note-prev:** text banks, local-window partial reuse and serial MTP are present but unqualified.
- **Qwen3.8-Flash-Next:** common UX baseline; configured values and verified combinations differ.
- **GLM 5.3 Flash:** serial graph is capped at 2,048 tokens; snapshots unsupported.
- **K2-Horizon 375B A23B:** 32K one-bank serving is qualified; disk KV and external owner import are not.
- **Inkling Small:** serial text snapshots present; media snapshots unsupported.
- **Step-3.7-Flash:** text banks are opt-in; Chat restart hits need history-stable identity; images serial.
- **MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL:** 256k serial text is the qualified context. Embedded MTP is qualified. Image, audio, and video projector execution is qualified. DFlash, 512k, and 1M are not qualified.

cargo test -p ds4-core --test serving_docs
